subject: Acme Corp POC - plan, success criteria, and weekly cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.com>; Daniel Park <daniel.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Sofia / Daniel,

Thanks again for the time today

good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: Run a 3-week POC to validate 1) latency & throughput for your customer-facing summarization pipeline, 2) end-to-end cost estimates at expected QPS, and 3) quality parity against your current rule-based extractor.
- Success criteria (what you asked for):
  - 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 1024-token responses under 5 concurrent requests
  - Average cost per 1k tokens below $0.40 (target)
  - F1 > 0.85 on the benchmark prompt set you provided
- Scope: Inference only (no model training). We'll run on Dedicated capacity in us-west for the trial.
- Timeline (proposed):
  - Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria + sign SOW
  - Week 1: environment setup & ingest small eval set
  - Week 2: run full-scale throughput tests + quality evals
  - Week 3: results, tuning, and final recommendations
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood)

-Rishi (Redwood)

infra & benchmarking; Sofia / Daniel (Acme)

product & dataset owners.

I've attached a draft POC plan and a starter SLA for review (POC-Plan-Acme-v2.docx, SLA-Draft-Acme.pdf). Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether we should shorten or extend the window to 4 weeks? Once agreed I'll send a one-page mutual action plan and calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@acme.com>

Date: 2026-08-24T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the summary, that's helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- The latency target looks reasonable; can we confirm whether 350ms is cold-start inclusive? We care mostly about steady-state but would like baseline cold-start numbers too.
- Cost target OK as a ballpark. We'll validate internally but don't expect to push lower than $0.35 right now.
- Dataset owners: I'll own the benchmark prompts, Daniel will own the production traces. We'll send the dataset link by EOD Monday.
- Timeline: 3 weeks works for us. If we need extra time for tuning we'll extend into week 4.

Please proceed with the mutual action plan and kickoff invite. Also add any reqs for VPN access / IP allowlisting so I can loop in our infra team.

Thanks

Sofia
